tasks.instruction: Update the is_shorts_eligible function signature and return type to match how it is called in youtubeBatchUpload.py. The caller at line 902 passes two arguments: source_info (a dict with keys 'duration', 'width', 'height') and max_duration (a float from args.shorts_max_seconds). The caller also unpacks the result as (eligible, reasons), so the function must return a Tuple[bool, List[str]]. Change the signature from (duration: float, width: int, height: int, max_duration: float) -> bool to (source_info: dict, max_duration: float = 60.0) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]. Inside the function, extract duration, width, height from source_info using .get(). Build a reasons list that appends a string explaining each failed check (e.g. 'duration exceeds max', 'not portrait or square orientation'). Return (False, reasons) when any check fails, and (True, []) when all checks pass. Add Tuple and List to the typing imports at the top of the file if not already present.
assertions: is_shorts_eligible accepts exactly two positional args: source_info dict and max_duration float
is_shorts_eligible returns a tuple of (bool, list)
reasons list is non-empty when eligible is False
reasons list is empty when eligible is True
